author: GamingBolt
description:
Pragmata certainly did a good job at hiding away what we consider to be a very exciting cliffhanger to build on that bittersweet ending. But for those of you who found it, you’re probably excited about a potential sequel to the game. But what would such a sequel entail? How could it take Hugh and Diana’s stories forward in a way that makes sense?

We did a bit of brainstorming, and it turns out that the franchise has quite a few options. Curious? Good. Join us as we look at the scope for a second round with Hugh and Diana, and possible ways for the next Pragmata game to cast a spell over us that’s just as strong as the new IP’s first outing.
title: Pragmata Ending Explained and How it Sets Up Pragmata 2

author: GamingBolt
description:
Overall, Invincible VS is a visually striking yet accessible fighter. Its immediate responsiveness makes it great for casuals, while hidden mechanical complexity and deep systems hold genuine competitive potential. 

There are, however, concerns around offensive balance and defensive clarity. Whether it fully realises its ambitions remains uncertain, but the foundation is strong enough to sustain high-level play for now, if not a lasting place in the FGC.
title: Invincible VS Review - Brutal And Surprisingly Deep

author: GamingBolt
description:
Supermassive Games’ The Dark Pictures Anthology has built a reputation on cinematic horror, and complex, branching narratives fed by player choice, but Directive 8020 looks like it’s going to push the series’ tried-and-tested formula further than ever before. 

This time, mixing with the series’ usual choice-led storytelling is a strong emphasis on real-time survival horror, signalling a shift in ambition and gameplay alike. Layering a diverse cast with mechanics designed to heighten tension and replayability, Directive 8020 could be the anthology’s most fully-realised entry yet. Here’s fifteen things you need to know before pulling the trigger.
title: Directive 8020 - 15 Things You NEED To Know Before You Buy
